marc_support: Hey team — urgent customer ticket. They say embeddings come back with 1024 dims but their contract/model is 1536. Billing spike too. Happened after they migrated some services and started sending a different set of headers. Can someone look?

anna_eng: Can you paste the request headers + a minimal request body? suspect an auth header routing/precedence issue.

marc_support: Pasting an anonymized curl they sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-AAA123" 
  -H "X-Org-Token: org_tok_OLD" 
  -H "X-Project-Id: proj-777" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-default","input":"hello world"}'
```
They say when they omitted X-Project-Id they still got 1024-dim embeddings (which matches another org).

kevin_sre: Quick thought — looks like the router is picking model based on the org token if present. If their org token is a leftover from a prior tenant (org_tok_OLD) it could be mapping to the smaller embed variant. I'll tail the auth proxy logs now.

marc_support: From the customer's logs: response headers include `x-embed-dim: 1024` and `x-model-selected: text-embed-small-1024`. They expected `text-embed-1536`.

anna_eng: If the auth middleware uses org_token as primary key and project header second, that would explain it. We changed precedence in the routing PR last week (to support org-level defaults). Might be too aggressive.

support-bot: INVESTIGATION-456 created and assigned to kevin_sre. ETA 4h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kevin_sre: Confirmed in proxy traces: decision_key = org_token + requested_model. We cache model selection per decision_key but we forgot to include project-id in the cache key. So cross-project requests sharing an org token hit the wrong cached model. Patch ready to include project id before cache lookup.

lisa_billing: @marc_support please collect a few affected request IDs and timestamps so billing can compute refunds/adjustments.

marc_support: Pushing two sample request ids from the customer's report: `req_20260301_aa12`, `req_20260301_bb34`. Also their customer id: cust-9012.

kevin_sre: Rolling out hotfix to canary now — change will make precedence: project header first, then org default. Also clearing the model-selection cache entries for the affected org_token keys. I'll post deploy IDs. :white_check_mark:

anna_eng: After hotfix, add unit tests for header precedence and an integration test that verifies embedding dims returned when multiple auth tokens/headers present. Also add a metric for "model-selection-fallbacks" so we can alert when org-defaults are used.

marc_support: Customer update draft: "We identified a routing cache bug that caused model selection to prefer an org token cached mapping over an explicit project header. We've deployed a hotfix and cleared the cache. We're offering a provisional credit for the affected usage while billing reconciles. Please confirm after you see correct dims."

lisa_billing: Got the request ids; I'll run reconciliation and follow up with a proposed credit amount.

kevin_sre: Deploy to canary: deploy_id=deploy-embed-routing-20260301-canary. Monitoring logs for `model-selection-mismatch` errors.

marc_support: Thanks — I'll keep the customer in the loop. Adding notes to the ticket: repro steps, logs, and mitigations. :grimacing:

anna_eng: One more mitigation: we can add a temporary server-side check that rejects requests where `x-model`/`model` in body conflicts with the selected model and include `x-warning: model-override` header to make it explicit to callers. But hotfix is best fix.

support-bot: INVESTIGATION-456 status: in-progress, assigned=kevin_sre, priority=high.

kevin_sre: Hotfix merged to staging; will promote to prod after 30m bake if no anomalies.

marc_support: Closing loop: customer confirmed dims are now 1536 for new calls. Billing will follow up. Thanks everyone.
